# Version 4.150.2
> **Ganesh and shader stability** · Released August 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.2/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.2 improves Ganesh failure recovery and fixes a native shader-compiler lifetime issue.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh failure recovery** — Prevents stale readbacks after failed flushes, restores resolve dirty-state tracking, and includes the Imagination GPU framebuffer-deletion workaround. ([#4517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4517), [#4561](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4561))
- **SkSL compiler lifetime correction** — Fixes a native use-after-free in Raster Pipeline shader code generation. ([#4663](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4663))

## Engine

- **Skia m150 servicing** — Refreshes the bundled m150 engine without changing the managed API or native C API. ([#4648](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4648))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.2

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
